content: Bulk creation: UniVoucher (up to 100 per tx, same amount/message), ZBD API (Promise.all parallel creation), BitGifty API (batch with retries + status tracking, recipientEmail param), GIFQ/Azteco (B2B bulk orders with volume pricing). Email delivery: BitGifty (recipientEmail in createGiftCard), Codego (virtual delivery by email in seconds, white-label), ZBD docs (send via email campaigns with HTML template). CSV upload for per-recipient variable amounts: not seen in any Lightning-native product; only enterprise gift card platforms (Giftbit, eGifter) support it. LNBits has no email extension for this.
